summary: Senior Android engineer with 10+ years in software engineering and 8+ years shipping Android apps, natively in Kotlin and Java and with React Native, for Walmart Global Tech (store, warehouse, and Spark Driver apps, 500K+ daily users), HCSC (1M+ members), and IBM/AEP. Strong OOP and CS foundation (data structures, algorithms, design patterns, MVVM / clean architecture) and deep Android framework knowledge: components and lifecycles, Jetpack (ViewModel, Room, WorkManager, Compose), Gradle, ProGuard/R8. Builds native Kotlin modules for React Native apps and SDK-style modules for identity (OAuth 2.0 / JWT, biometrics), payments, and analytics. Mobile TDD with Espresso, Robolectric, JUnit, Appium, Jest, and Detox; CI/CD on GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, and Jenkins to Google Play with phased rollouts, feature flags, and Crashlytics/Dynatrace monitoring (99.9% crash-free). Integrates GenAI (Azure AI Services, Claude API) into mobile workflows; Scrum delivery with clear written and verbal communication across onshore and offshore teams.
